statusLine: IMPLEMENTED / AUTOMATED TECHNICAL PASS / NATIVE AUTH PARTIAL PASS / NATIVE SEARCH TRUTH UNVERIFIED / NATIVE UX UNVERIFIED / USER EXPERIENCE PARTIAL PASS

baseline.source: 2026-08-08 user visible-desktop screenshots and feedback, followed by read-only code-path audit

observations.finding: 打开数据库会话 and 登录我的图书馆 represented different intended identities, but both invoked the same legacy session-plus-shared-browser chain; 打开机构浏览器 or 机构网页已在侧栏 controlled only the same presentation surface.
observations.productImpact: Users saw multiple controls without a clear distinction between an authentication goal and a browser surface.

observations.finding: Closing the login browser did not have one transaction authority that inspected the closing page, refreshed the bound parent, and committed a goal-specific terminal state.
observations.productImpact: A successful-looking browser login could leave Sidera reporting not signed in.

observations.finding: The visible ten candidates did not distinguish retrieval limit from local page size and did not expose total-hit availability, coverage, provider order, deduplication, or completion reason.
observations.productImpact: Users could not tell why these ten records were shown or what portion of the source had been searched.

observations.finding: The automated structured route remained the existing WHU academic-discovery capability. WOS, CNKI, and Scopus were not connected as automated providers.
observations.productImpact: Manual database access could not be described as Sidera multi-source automated discovery.

observations.finding: Opening a supplier website alone does not automate discovery, review, controlled import, clustering, visualization, or Agent evidence use.
observations.productImpact: Database direct access is a manual access and failure-recovery surface, not the product's primary value.

observations.finding: Page title, institution description, authentication status, source cards, search controls, and persistent browser buttons stacked vertically before results.
observations.productImpact: The first actionable evidence records were pushed below the initial viewport.

authentication.closeVerification: The close request enters verifying and uses one four-second deadline. Library-account performs one current-page inspection and, when proof is still unknown, navigates and directly polls the same visible WebView/environment at the fixed library landing. Database-access and discovery-fulltext retain three current-page checks plus the hidden bound-parent reload route.
authentication.terminalStability: Ready cannot be downgraded by a late close; failed or cancelled transactions preserve previously proven readiness.
authentication.mainWindowRestore: claimed at most once by the current transaction

managedLibraryPopup.transactionBinding: current transaction ID plus generation token
managedLibraryPopup.stalePopupBehavior: closed or ignored; cannot change authentication truth

authentication.browserRole: login, manual access, original-record inspection, and diagnostic fallback; never the authentication authority

searchTruth.unknownTotalContract: totalHits remains absent when the provider did not prove a total; the returned candidate count is not substituted.

libraryAccount.securityBoundary: Credentials, Cookie, ticket, form values, query parameters, and fragments were not captured in Sidera state or evidence.

supersededNativeTimeline.observation: First login persisted the official session, but the page became blank and closing the window left Sidera at authentication required; a second open was already signed in and then became ready.
supersededNativeTimeline.diagnosis: Authentication succeeded, but the first popup/opener handoff was lost by URL replay.

supersededNativeTimeline.observation: An intermediate candidate could remain in authenticating after the user closed the window.

nativeAuthenticationAcceptance.finalRepair: A coordinator-bound managed child WebView preserves official popup, POST, opener, and shared WebView2 environment semantics. Close verification now reserves the four-second deadline for one current inspection followed by direct polling of the fixed library landing in that same visible WebView/environment; stale token, generation, and terminal callbacks remain unable to commit.

main window clickable after authentication-window close

authentication.remaining: Discovery fulltext plus the complete cross-goal, restart, and invalidation matrix remain unverified. The historical first-transaction failure and bounded second-entry recovery remain retained even though the latest first-transaction retest passed.

searchTruth.required: Visible Chinese and English searches must verify 40 and 100 targets, filters, deduplication, known or unknown total, provider breakdown, retrievalPosition.connectorId, local ten-record pages, display sorting, and cross-page selection without claiming unavailable providers.

ux.observedAuthFlow: After the latest session-cleared first transaction reached ready, the user manually closed the authentication window; the main window remained clickable and no abnormal window remained.
ux.required: Normal and maximized windows must still separately verify first-screen hierarchy, the default-closed drawer, browser split presentation, search-result presentation, and failure recovery.
